Refunds every talent point and undoes your class specialization.
block.isekai_mahou.reincarnation_altar.t: Be reborn as another race or class: your level stays, what belonged only to the old one is lost.
Cost: %s (race) or %s (class) Mana Crystals + 1 Guardian Core.
character.isekai_mahou.feat.arachnid: Survive the Labyrinth: ambush %s creatures underground (no sky above).
character.isekai_mahou.feat.demon: Kill %s creatures with fire or in the Nether.
character.isekai_mahou.feat.elf: Kill %s creatures at range (arrows or projectile spells).
character.isekai_mahou.feat.phantom: Kill %s creatures at night (or in skyless dimensions).
character.isekai_mahou.feat.slime: Devour %s things (food, or creatures Predator can copy).
character.isekai_mahou.form.angel.desc: Huge wings of light (GLIDING, like elytra; dive = Heavenly Descent) and a radiant halo: every 2 s heals you and nearby allies and holy rays strike up to 2 enemies (double on the undead); +20% Spell Power and +8 health.
character.isekai_mahou.form.angel.power_: a burst of light (10 blocks): hurts every enemy (double on the undead) and greatly heals allies.
character.isekai_mahou.form.arachnid.des: Kumoko's final evolution: a spider body with eight legs — climbs walls fast, +20% speed and attack speed, hits with Poison II and Slowness, falls 12 blocks unharmed, a 28-block Spider Thread every 1.5 s, 4 traps and the Evil Eye every 2 s (sometimes Petrifies).
character.isekai_mahou.form.arachnid.pow: webs on everyone within 8 blocks: damage, Rooted, Slowness IV and Poison II.
character.isekai_mahou.form.beastfolk.de: +35% speed, +30% attack speed, +20% damage, higher jumps, 25% dodge and your hits cause Bleeding.
character.isekai_mahou.form.beastfolk.po: leap at the prey most in line with your gaze (up to 14 blocks) and maul it (damage and Bleeding).
character.isekai_mahou.form.demon.desc: The power of Anos Voldigoad: shadow wings (GLIDING, like elytra; dive = Abyssal Plunge), immune to fire, +30% melee damage and +20% Spell Power; your hits burn with black flames, an Abyssal aura hurts whoever gets close and the Eyes of Destruction undo spells with twice the chance.
character.isekai_mahou.form.demon.power_: a black sun flies to the aimed spot (20 blocks) and explodes in a 4.5 radius: high damage, Burning and Corrupted.
character.isekai_mahou.form.dragonborn.d: A Dragon Slayer's peak: dragon wings in your ancestry's color (GLIDING, like elytra), +8 armor, +25% melee damage, 30% larger and −25% damage taken; melee hits carry the element and Devour Element recharges in 6 s. While gliding, the racial key becomes Draconic Dive (looking down: area crater) or Strafing Breath (looking ahead).
character.isekai_mahou.form.dragonborn.p: the Dragon Slayer's roar: a 10-block cone in your ancestry's element (fire burns, water chills, earth petrifies, wind pushes, light exposes, shadow corrupts).
character.isekai_mahou.form.dwarf.desc: Grows 45% with rock skin: +10 armor, +6 toughness, immune to knockback, +30% melee damage, −30% damage taken and mines twice as fast; a bit slower.
character.isekai_mahou.form.dwarf.power_: the ground cracks in a 6-block radius: damage, launches up and Stuns.
character.isekai_mahou.form.elf.desc: A leaf crown and green aura: +15% speed and Spell Power, +50% resource regeneration, +30% arrow damage and Regeneration for you and nearby allies.
character.isekai_mahou.form.elf.power_de: up to 8 enemies ahead (16 blocks) take damage and are Rooted.
character.isekai_mahou.form.half_orc.des: Geld the Orc Lord's evolution: a crimson aura, +50% melee damage, +25% attack speed, +15% speed, 20% of melee damage heals you and Ravenous Hunger goes up to 8 — but you take +10% damage.
character.isekai_mahou.form.half_orc.pow: devours the strength of everyone within 8 blocks: damage, Weak, Slow and Exposed; 25% of the damage heals you, each prey fills Ravenous Hunger and allies gain Strength.
character.isekai_mahou.form.human.desc: A golden hero's aura: cleanses harmful effects, heals 30%, +25% melee damage and Spell Power, +10 health, +10% speed and −20% damage taken.
character.isekai_mahou.form.human.power_: a golden crescent that hits everyone ahead (high damage and knockback).
character.isekai_mahou.form.phantom.desc: Become a ghost: invisible to creatures, slow FLIGHT, hits and projectiles deal half, no fall damage and +15% Spell Power.
character.isekai_mahou.form.phantom.powe: dash 8 blocks in a straight line through enemies: damage, Weakness and Chilled to everyone in the way.
character.isekai_mahou.form.slime.desc: Like Rimuru at the Harvest Festival: takes a golden-eyed humanoid form — huge regeneration (3+ health per second), +20 health, immune to knockback and falls, higher jumps and −15% damage; strong hits split off clone-blobs that burst into acid and every devoured creature is analyzed at once (1 sample is enough).
character.isekai_mahou.form.slime.power_: swallows the smaller enemies around you (pull, high damage and heals half of it) — whoever dies becomes a copied ability; big ones take acid and Slowness.
character.isekai_mahou.mimic.creeper.des: below 30% health, bursts into acid (once every 60 s)
character.isekai_mahou.passive.angel.lv2: Regenerates every 4 s and +10% damage against the undead.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.angel.lv3: Regenerates every 3 s and +20% damage against the undead.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.angel.lv4: Regenerates +2 every 3 s, +25% against the undead and your little wings soften falls (−15% gravity).
Darkvision, climbs walls SLOWLY (Shift clings) and Spider Thread (Shift + racial key): a 12-block thread pulls you to the wall — or pulls the enemy to you.
Climbs faster, hits poison (Poison I, 2 s), 16-block thread and Thread Trap: crouch still for 2 s to leave an invisible thread that roots and poisons (2 at a time).
Poison lasts 3 s, 20-block thread, 3 traps and Paralysis Evil Eye: every 6 s the enemy you stare at almost freezes.
Climbs fast, Poison II, +5% speed, 24-block thread and Curse Evil Eye: every 4 s, Paralysis + Corrupted.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.beastfolk: +4% speed and fall 1 extra block without getting hurt.
+6% speed and +2 blocks of safe fall.
10% chance to dodge hits and projectiles (at most once every 2 s), +8% speed and +3 safe fall.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.demon.lv1: Darkvision and −20% damage from fire and lava.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.demon.lv2: −35% fire damage and +8% damage with your fire spells.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.demon.lv3: Half fire damage, +12% with fire spells, −15% from enemy fire spells and Hellish Rebuke (whoever strikes you catches fire).
character.isekai_mahou.passive.demon.lv4: +15% with fire spells, −25% from enemy fire spells and Magic Eyes of Destruction: 15% chance to destroy an enemy spell before it hits you (once every 20 s).
character.isekai_mahou.passive.dragonbor: −15% fire damage, +1 safe fall and Devour Element (Shift + racial key): eat your ancestry's element nearby to recover 3 health, 15% mana and hunger (30 s cooldown).
+8% with ancestry spells and −15% from enemy spells of that element. Devour: 4 health, 20% mana and Sated for 10 s (+15% with ancestry spells).
−25% fire damage, +12% / −25% in your ancestry's element and +2 safe fall. Devour: 5 health, 25% mana, 20 s cooldown.
+15% with ancestry spells and +2 armor (scales). Devour: 6 health and 30% mana.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.dwarf.lv1: Sees in the dark underground and +10% mining speed.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.dwarf.lv3: Immune to poison, +20% mining speed, +3 armor and +15% knockback resistance.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.dwarf.lv4: +25% mining speed, +4 armor and +25% knockback resistance.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.elf.lv2: +8% damage with projectiles (arrows and Projectile, Arrow or Moon Arrow spells) and +8% resource regeneration.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.elf.lv3: +12% projectile damage, +12% resource regeneration and Hidden Mana: while crouching your mana vanishes (distant monsters lose your trail; the first hit is a surprise).
+3% melee damage. Starved: eating or a melee kill grants Ravenous Hunger (+2% melee damage each, 30 s; up to 2) and a kill devours the prey (+1 health and hunger).
+5% melee damage, +4 max health and Ravenous Hunger up to 3.
+6% melee damage, +6 health, Ravenous Hunger up to 4 and Relentless: once every 5 min a fatal blow leaves you at 1 health. Below 35% health, +20% melee damage.
+8% melee damage, +8 max health and Ravenous Hunger up to 5.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.human.lv2: +12% XP per kill and Adaptation: −15% from the SAME damage type taken in the last 8 s (up to 3 types).
character.isekai_mahou.passive.human.lv3: +15% XP per kill, Adaptation −20% and +5% Spell Power.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.human.lv4: +20% XP per kill, Adaptation −25% and +10% Spell Power.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.phantom.l: Darkvision and falls slowly (−15% gravity, +2 safe fall). Half-translucent body.
10% chance for hits and projectiles to pass through you (at most once every 2 s); −30% gravity.
15% chance to phase, −35% gravity and +6 safe fall.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.slime.lv1: Regenerates +1 health every 5 s. Predator: slay creatures (spider, wolf, bat, creeper, blaze, water creatures, zombie) — after 3 samples the Great Sage copies one of their abilities. Holds 2.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.slime.lv2: Regenerates every 4 s, −25% fall damage and bounces back when falling from high (Shift = no bounce). Holds 3 abilities.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.slime.lv3: Regenerates every 3 s, −50% fall damage and whoever hits you gets stuck to you (Slowness). Holds 4 abilities.
character.isekai_mahou.passive.slime.lv4: Regenerates +2 every 3 s, −75% fall damage, +2 armor and +20% steadiness. Holds 5 abilities (6 at level V).
A golden halo floats above your head and glows in the dark.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.angel_wings: Small feathered wings on your back — in Seraphic Form they become huge wings of light.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.arachnid_cl: Walk into a wall to climb; Shift sticks; letting go slides down slowly. No fall damage while on the wall.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.arachnid_ev: From race level III: the enemy you stare at is Paralyzed every few seconds; from IV also Cursed; as an Arachne, sometimes Petrified.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.arachnid_ey: Four extra eyes on your forehead: see in the dark (racial key or the tab toggles it).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.arachnid_th: Shift + racial key: a thread pulls you to the aimed block (climb, cross chasms) or pulls the aimed enemy to you. No fall damage right after.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.arachnid_tr: From race level II: crouch still for 2 s to leave an invisible thread on the ground (lasts 60 s). The first enemy to step on it is Rooted and Poisoned.
Falls from higher without getting hurt with every race level.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.beast_speed: Gets faster with every race level.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.demon_darkv: See in the dark (toggle: Shift + racial key or in the tab).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.demon_destr: From race level IV: 15% chance to destroy an enemy spell before it hits you (once every 20 s; 30% as Demon King).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.demon_rebuk: From race level III: whoever strikes you in melee catches fire (at most once every 8 s).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.dragon_ance: Your draconic blood takes your class's main element: it colors your scales, your breath, your wings and your resistances.
Shift + racial key: eat your element nearby — fire (fire, lava, magma, campfire), water (water or rain), earth (stone, dirt, iron), wind (open sky), light (sun or bright light), shadow (darkness). Heals, restores mana and hunger.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.dwarf_darkv: See in the dark while underground (toggle: Shift + racial key or in the tab).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.elf_attunem: At night, under the open sky, Moon Arrow is 20% stronger.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.elf_conceal: From race level III: while crouching your mana vanishes — distant monsters lose your trail and Mana Sense can't see you. The first hit reveals everything in a surprise attack (then 10 s to hide again).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.elf_darkvis: See in dark places (toggle: Shift + racial key or in the tab).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.human_ambit: No weakness of blood: fits any class and any path.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.orc_hot_blo: Wounded (below half health), Savage Cleave deals +50% damage.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.orc_starved: Eating or a melee kill fills Ravenous Hunger (+2% melee damage each, 30 s). A kill devours the prey: +1 health and hunger.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.phantom_eye: See in the dark (Shift + racial key or in the tab).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.phantom_flo: A half-translucent body that falls slowly and sheds mist.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.slime_bounc: From race level II: you bounce back when falling from high (Shift = no bounce).
character.isekai_mahou.trait.slime_jelly: A translucent jelly body that wobbles, regenerates and sticks to whoever hits you.
character.isekai_mahou.trait.slime_preda: Slay creatures to copy abilities: Sticky Thread (spider), Tempest Wolf Step (wolf), Ultrasound (bat), Jelly Burst (creeper), Flame Resistance (blaze), Water Breathing (water creatures) and Rot Resistance (zombie). When full, the oldest is forgotten.
An analytical voice in your head: it speaks when an analysis starts or ends and when your health turns critical. Shift + racial key: report of your copied abilities.
commands.isekai_mahou.character.rebuild: Free race change opened for %s player(s).
commands.isekai_mahou.character.transfor: Forced the Transformation on %s player(s) (no level V or cooldown needed).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_acid_splash.desc: Slime racial skill. Effect: a blob of corrosive goo — damage, Exposed (the acid eats armor), Soaked and Slowness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_adaptive.desc: Human racial skill. Augment: the previous effect deals +25% damage, or +50% against targets already suffering a condition or harmful effect.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_blood_fury.desc: Half-Orc racial skill. Effect: pay 10% of your health and rage for 10 s — +25% melee damage, faster attacks and steps, and 15% of melee damage heals you. With Invert: Bleeding on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_divine_shield.de: Angel racial skill. Effect: wings of light shield the target — Absorption (stronger with Amplify), Resistance for 6 s and puts out fire. Works on allies too; with Invert, the light exposes the enemy (Glowing, Exposed and Weakness).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_dragon_breath.de: Draconic racial skill. Form: a 7-block cone from your mouth that applies the effects to everything in sight. It takes the spell's element (pure Arcane = your ancestry's); in your ancestral element, +25% power.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_dragon_scales.de: Draconic racial skill. Effect: draconic scales for 12 s — +armor, −25% spell damage and 20% of melee damage is reflected. With Invert: tears the enemy's scales off (Exposed).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_forest_step.desc: Elf racial skill. Effect: on yourself, vanish in a swirl of leaves and reappear up to 8 blocks ahead (never through walls), gain speed and enemies lose your trail. On allies: speed and regeneration. With Invert: roots hold the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_forge_shout.desc: Dwarf racial skill. Effect: a roar with the forge's heat — fire damage, knockback, stun and burning. On yourself (Self): repairs 10% of your equipped weapons and armor and grants Strength.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_hellfire.desc: Demon racial skill. Effect: fire of the Abyss — fire damage, Burning, Corrupted and flames for 5 s; water won't put it out: wet targets take +25%.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_holy_light.desc: Angel racial skill. Effect: a ray of light from the sky — light damage (DOUBLE on the undead) and Glowing, and you heal for 15% of the damage. On yourself (Self): heals and puts out fire.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_jelly_body.desc: Slime racial skill. Effect: your body turns to jelly — Regeneration II for 5 s, Resistance for 10 s and a bounce upward. Works on allies too; with Invert, the jelly pins the enemy (Rooted and strong Slowness).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_moon_arrow.desc: Elf racial skill. Form: a swift moonlight arrow that curves on its own toward the enemy ahead; at night, under the sky, +20% power. Works with Split, Scatter, Pierce, Ricochet, Homing, Phantom and Accelerate.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_phase_shift.desc: Phantom racial skill. Effect: on yourself, turn into mist — Invisibility and Speed for 5 s, intangible for 1 s and glide up to 6 blocks ahead through creatures (never walls). On allies: Invisibility and Speed. With Invert: Blindness and Exposed on the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_predator_leap.de: Beastfolk racial skill. Form: leap at the prey most in line with your gaze (up to 14 blocks) and, on landing, apply the effects around you. Works with no effect (just the leap); the fall doesn't hurt.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_resolve.desc: Human racial skill. Effect: removes harmful effects and conditions (except Magic Exhaustion), heals and grants Absorption. Works on allies too; with Invert, breaks an enemy's will (strips good effects and leaves it Exposed).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_savage_cleave.de: Half-Orc racial skill. Effect: a brutal gash — high damage, Bleeding and knockback; below half health, +50% damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_shadow_wings.des: Demon racial skill. Effect: shadow wings — a wingbeat up and forward and, for 12 s, lower gravity (you can glide), safe falls and speed. With Invert: the shadow drags the enemy down (Darkness and Slowness).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_spectral_touch.d: Phantom racial skill. Effect: a spirit's cold hand passes through the target — shadow damage, Chilled and Weakness; 25% of the damage heals you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_stone_skin.desc: Dwarf racial skill. Effect: skin turns to granite for 12 s — +armor, +steadiness and −15% damage taken, slightly slower. Works on allies too; with Invert, petrifies the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_venom_fang.desc: Arachnid racial skill. Effect: a venomous bite — damage, Poison II and Weakness; against an already poisoned target, +40% damage. On yourself (Self): draws out your own poison.
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_web_shot.desc: Arachnid racial skill. Effect: a ball of web sticks to the target — light damage, Rooted and strong Slowness. On yourself (Self): a silk thread breaks your fall (Slow Falling).
glyph.isekai_mahou.race_wild_instinct.de: Beastfolk racial skill. Effect: for 12 s, +speed, faster attacks and 20% dodge; on yourself, your nose marks hostile beasts within 20 blocks. With Invert: frightens the enemy (Weakness and Slowness).
hint.isekai_mahou.character.altars: Regret your talents? Find an Altar of New Beginnings. Race and class only change at the rare Altar of Reincarnation.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_arachne_silk.des: A spool of silk that never snaps. Spiders, cave spiders, void crawlers and abandoned mineshaft chests sometimes keep one.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_beast_claw.desc: An alpha predator's claws on a cord. The Manticore always; dire wolves and lizardmen sometimes.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_demon_horn.desc: A horn still smoldering. Demonic patrons and the Abyss Throne keep them.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_dragon_scale.des: An ancestral scale. The Wyvern King and the Primordial Dragon always leave one.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_dwarven_rune.des: A forge rune, still warm. Kobolds steal them from dwarves and hide them in their dens.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_elven_tear.desc: A crystallized tear of moonlight. Fairies, enchanted lakes and druid circles sometimes keep one.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_human_emblem.des: The crest of an old royal house. Kept in guilds and city chests.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_orc_fang.desc: The tusk of an orc champion. Orcs sometimes carry one; the Orc Lord always does.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_phantom_ectoplas: A flask of whispering mist. Phantoms and vexes sometimes drop one; the Lich always does, and the Forgotten Crypt keeps them.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_seraph_feather.d: A golden feather that still glows. The Seraph always leaves one; angel sentinels, cherubs and the celestial sanctuary sometimes.
item.isekai_mahou.relic_slime_core.desc: A king's jelly heart. The King Slime always leaves one; slimes and magma cubes, rarely.
message.isekai_mahou.character.altar_far: You moved away from the Altar of Reincarnation.
message.isekai_mahou.character.altar_no_: Choose your class before being reborn.
message.isekai_mahou.character.class_in_: Finish your Transformation before being reborn.
message.isekai_mahou.character.class_inv: That class can't be chosen at the altar.
message.isekai_mahou.character.class_reb: Your life as a %1$s is behind you: talents, origin glyphs (%3$s forgotten), ranks and class items are gone. Your level, Circle and elements remain. Welcome, %2$s.
message.isekai_mahou.character.class_sto: %s is a fate, not a choice: the altar can't undo it.
message.isekai_mahou.character.demon_boa: "A spell like that can't reach a Demon King."
"I didn't even need a second look."
message.isekai_mahou.character.dragon_ea: Nothing to devour here — look for %s.
fire, lava, magma or a lit campfire
the sun or a bright light
message.isekai_mahou.character.form_awak: ✦ TRANSFORMATION AWAKENED: %s! Press %s to transform (while transformed, the same key uses the form strike).
message.isekai_mahou.character.form_lock: %s awakens at race level V (level %s + the race deed). See the Race tab.
message.isekai_mahou.character.form_titl: The blood of your race awakens!
message.isekai_mahou.character.glide_hin: Wings spread! %1$s twice to take off (or %1$s mid-air to glide) · hold %1$s or %2$s to flap · %3$s folds your wings · gliding and looking down, %4$s = %5$s.
message.isekai_mahou.character.glide_no_: No energy left to flap your wings!
message.isekai_mahou.character.legacy_bo: Each race has a growing passive, racial skills you assemble in the Grimoire and a Transformation. Open the menu (%s) → Race tab to choose — without redoing your class.
message.isekai_mahou.character.mitosis: Mitosis! A clone-blob splits off and bursts into acid!
message.isekai_mahou.character.not_creat: Choose your race first (menu → Race tab).
message.isekai_mahou.character.relic_all: You already master every skill of the %s.
message.isekai_mahou.character.relic_lea: ✦ The relic dissolves into light: you learned %s, a racial skill of the %s! Assemble it in the Grimoire (menu %s). It is yours forever.
message.isekai_mahou.character.relic_sam: You already carry this bloodline (%s): its skills come with your blood. Sneak + right click to turn the relic into XP.
message.isekai_mahou.character.relic_xp: The relic dissolves into experience: +%s XP.
message.isekai_mahou.character.renewal_f: You walked away from the Altar of New Beginnings.
message.isekai_mahou.character.renewal_n: You have no spent talent points and no specialization to undo.
message.isekai_mahou.character.renewed: A new beginning! Your talents are back.
message.isekai_mahou.character.renewed_b: Every talent point is back and your specialization was undone. Open the menu (%s) and build again.
message.isekai_mahou.character.sage_all: Every known ability has been copied.
message.isekai_mahou.character.sage_warn: Warning: critical damage. I recommend retreating.
message.isekai_mahou.character.skill_awa: ✦ Racial skill awakened: %s! Assemble it in the Grimoire (menu %s).
message.isekai_mahou.character.skill_wro: %s is a racial skill of the %s: only that race's Racial Relic can teach it to you.
message.isekai_mahou.character.skills_fo: With your old blood went its skills: %s (those learned from Racial Relics stay).
message.isekai_mahou.character.skills_in: Your race has no darkvision — your racial skills are in the Grimoire (menu %s).
message.isekai_mahou.character.thread_mi: Nothing in reach to anchor the thread.
overlay.isekai_mahou.character.level_sub: Your racial passive grew stronger — see the Race tab
race.isekai_mahou.angel.desc: Children of the sky with a golden halo and small feathered wings. Holy light heals allies and burns the undead.
race.isekai_mahou.arachnid.desc: Reborn as the smallest spider in the Great Labyrinth — just like Kumoko, from Kumo desu ga. Climbs walls, shoots threads, sets traps and, as it evolves, gains the Evil Eyes. Starts as a Small Lesser Taratect... and ends as an Arachne.
race.isekai_mahou.beastfolk.desc: Half person, half beast: alert ears, a restless tail, a hunter's nose and a predator's leap.
race.isekai_mahou.demon.desc: Heirs of the Demon King of Tyranny — Anos Voldigoad, from Maou Gakuin. Horns, shadow wings, Abyssal fire and Magic Eyes that destroy spells. Confident to an absurd degree... and with good reason.
race.isekai_mahou.dragonborn.desc: Dragon blood and the magic of the Dragon Slayers (Fairy Tail): they eat their ancestry's element to recover health and mana, roar like dragons and, at their peak, unleash Dragon Force. They say a storm dragon, sealed for centuries, still laughs inside this bloodline.
race.isekai_mahou.dwarf.desc: Short, sturdy and stubborn as stone. Born miners and masters of the forge, they see in the depths and laugh at poison.
race.isekai_mahou.elf.desc: Children of the ancient forests, with keen senses and flawless aim. They see in the dark, the moon guides their arrows and, like Frieren, they learn to hide their own mana.
race.isekai_mahou.half_orc.desc: Blood of the Horde — and the hunger of Geld, the Orc Lord from Tensura. The more it eats and devours, the stronger it gets; it endures what would kill anyone else and, in the end, awakens as the Orc Disaster.
race.isekai_mahou.human.desc: Versatile and stubborn, humans adapt to any path. Every legend of this world began with a human who refused to give up.
race.isekai_mahou.phantom.desc: A soul that came back with a body of mist: half translucent, light as the wind, sees in the dark and lets blows pass through.
race.isekai_mahou.slime.desc: Reincarnated as a little drop of jelly — just like Rimuru, from Tensura. Regenerates, bounces and, with Predator, devours creatures to copy their abilities, guided by the voice of the Great Sage. Underestimated... until it awakens as a Demon Lord.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.all_free: Every race is available — pick the one that suits you.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.altar_info: Change race or class: Altar of Reincarnation (rare shrines; very expensive). Redo talents: Altar of New Beginnings.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.altar_note: Being reborn as another race is expensive: the passive and racial skills change with it (feats are kept).
screen.isekai_mahou.character.class_keep: Level, Circle, awakened elements, common glyphs, race and everything that isn't class-bound.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.class_lose: Everything that belonged only to the %s: talents and specialization, origin glyphs (and spells built with them), ritual ranks and class items in your inventory.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.feat_note: Deeds count for every race, even before rebirth.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.foreign_sk: Learned from a Racial Relic: yours forever.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.form_requi: Transformation (race level V): level %s + race deed — %s
screen.isekai_mahou.character.form_timin: Lasts %s s · %s min cooldown. While transformed, the racial key uses the form strike.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.hub_class_: Keeps your level, Circle and elements. Loses the old class's talents, origin glyphs, ranks and items.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.hub_note: To only redo your talents, find the Altar of New Beginnings.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.hub_race_d: The passive and racial skills change with it. Your race feats are kept.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.key_none: the Transformation comes at race level V — your skills are in the Grimoire
Shift + racial key: Great Sage report.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.next_form: Race level V: level %s (you are level %s) + deed: %s (%s/%s).
screen.isekai_mahou.character.next_level: Race level %s at level %s (you are level %s).
screen.isekai_mahou.character.note: Every race starts weak and grows through race levels I–V up to its Transformation.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.predator_n: None yet — slay creatures for the Great Sage to analyze.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.race_level: Max race level: your Transformation is unlocked!
screen.isekai_mahou.character.relic_line: Skills of other races: Racial Relics. This race's is: %s.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.relics_not: Skills of other races: Racial Relics (Human Emblem, Elven Tear, Dwarven Rune, Orc Fang, Demonic Horn, Draconic Scale, Beast Claw, Arachne Silk, Ancient Ectoplasm, Seraphic Feather, Royal Slime Core). They drop from creatures, bosses and chests tied to each race.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.renewal_li: Every spent talent point comes back for you to spend again.
Your specialization is undone: pick another (or the same) in the menu.
Level, Circle, glyphs, race and class do not change.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.renewal_ot: To change race or class, find the Altar of Reincarnation.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.skill_cost: Glyph cost: +%s mana (the Grimoire shows the final cost)
screen.isekai_mahou.character.skill_know: You already know this skill: assemble it in the Grimoire.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.skills_not: The 1st skill comes with your blood; the 2nd awakens at level %s (race level II). Assemble them in the Grimoire with any form, effect or augment.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.skills_tab: Assemble your racial skills in the Grimoire (menu %s → Grimoire). Other races can only learn them with this race's Racial Relic.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.tab_note: Once confirmed, it can only be changed at an Altar of Reincarnation.
screen.isekai_mahou.character.title: Choose your Race
screen.isekai_mahou.character.unbuilt_de: You haven't chosen your race yet. Choose now to gain its passive, racial skills and the path to its Transformation!
tooltip.isekai_mahou.character.relic_for: Relic skills are yours forever — not even rebirth takes them.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.character.relic_sam: Already of this race? Sneak + right click: +%s XP.

tooltip.isekai_mahou.character.relic_use: Right click: learn the next skill you don't know (consumes the relic).
